name: Customer.io
description: Send customers, orders, carts and subscriptions to Customer.io

images.title: Every store event, in Customer.io
images.description: Orders, shipments, abandoned carts and subscriptions reach Customer.io as they happen, each tied to the customer's profile.

images.title: Profiles that stay current
images.description: Every customer becomes a person with contact details, marketing consent, order count and total spent, updated on each change.

images.title: Abandoned carts, ready to recover
images.description: Cart Abandoned arrives with the products, prices, images and the link that brings the shopper back to their cart.

images.title: Set up in a minute
images.description: Paste your Site ID and API key, test the connection and switch it on. One action sends the customers you already have.
